    {"name": "Greenleaf Grocery", "account": "041-3390-7741", "category": "groceries", "source": "bank"},
    {"name": "Brightpath Contractors", "account": "052-8814-2206", "category": "payroll", "source": "bank"},
    {"name": "Fennick Books", "account": "052-8814-2206", "category": "income", "source": "bank"},
    {"name": "Adobe", "account": "052-8814-2206", "category": "software", "source": "bank"},
]

venmo_payees = [
    {"name": "tix-resale-22", "account": "Venmo", "category": "tickets", "source": "venmo"},
    {"name": "northside_prop", "account": "Venmo", "category": "personal", "source": "venmo"},
    {"name": "sam-rivera", "account": "Venmo", "category": "personal", "source": "venmo"},
    {"name": "nymaids00", "account": "Venmo", "category": "services", "source": "venmo"},
    {"name": "amy-lin", "account": "Venmo", "category": "personal", "source": "venmo"},
]

csv_data = [
    {
        "vendor_name": payee["name"],
        "platform": payee["source"],
        "category": payee.get("category", ""),
        "service_account": payee.get("service_account", ""),
        "account_number": payee.get("account", ""),
        "status": "active" if payee.get("payee_id") else "transaction"
    }
    for payee in bank_payees + venmo_payees
]

csv_data.sort(key=lambda x: (x["category"], x["vendor_name"]))

with open('/workspace/consolidated_vendors_Q3_naive.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=["vendor_name", "platform", "category", "service_account", "account_number", "status"])
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerows(csv_data)

print("Created consolidated_vendors_Q3_naive.csv")
